scope: S3/S4 identity-preserving local neural engineering validation; zero physical steps, zero training, zero external research
implementation: existing engine/neural_cond.py ConductanceNetwork and ConductanceParams unchanged; backward_euler voltage
receptor_assumption: pure acetylcholine excitatory; pure gaba and glutamate inhibitory. Illustrative receptor assumptions, NOT receptor measurement. Unknown/mixed source labels excluded.
normalization: weight_uS = total_conductance_uS * source_synapse_count / sum(strict incoming source_synapse_count for same post), across excitatory and inhibitory together; no invented edges
physiology_status: all node and receptor parameters illustrative, uncalibrated; historical module physiology remains uncalibrated
input_ports: leg_sensory_nerve_union intersect selected, excluding four ambiguous SENSORY_CHANNEL_REVIEW cache IDs; descending_boundary intersect selected; sensory and descending disjoint, neither contains any motor neuron; ascending sensory overlap preserved

probes.interpretation: constant or single rectangular pulse engineering current, NOT brain output and NOT measured physiology
probes.calibration: single pulse on all allowed sensory and all descending identities together
chosen_followup: same combined pulse with zero connectivity software control
physical-qualified only: source CSV channel claw/hook/hairplate/campaniform intersect allowed sensory, zero DN
same physical-qualified pulse plus declared DN pulse
probes.parent_steering_before_any_probe: Only claw angle, hook velocity, hairplate coxa angle and campaniform load physically encoded by parent; bristle/club/noxious absent and zero. Broad engineering sensory pulse does NOT establish physical-feedback propagation. Check restricted union separately and report zero/weak strict source coverage honestly.

bounded_calibration.acceptance_rule: combined pulse recruits at least 16 distinct exported MN; aggregate MN rate during full 200ms strictly between 0 and 100Hz; maximum individual MN full-window mean below 200Hz; all state finite, voltage within [-90,-49]mV after reset; choose first passing in order .02,.005,.08; save every failed probe. If none passes, retain .02 and report calibration failure without claiming functional readiness.

validation.identity: compare all selected root IDs/cache indices, all strict edges, CSV motor order; source file hashes; role disjointness and all391MN no direct input
validation.guard: reject any nonzero outside sensory or descending independently, including role swap, MN, nonfinite, wrong shape, invalid duration
validation.numerical: independently scalar-reimplement sampled row event scatter, backward Euler, decay, threshold/refractory/delay/filter math against randomized state and recorded-input runs; independently queue spikes by absolute arrival timestamps
validation.quiet_control: zero input gives exactly zero spikes and motor rates from reset
validation.noedge_control: same legal engineering pulse, zero software connectivity, directly injected sensory/DN can spike but allMN remain silent; not lesion/surgical experiment
validation.replay: identical .5ms recorded inputs give bitwise identical sampled output and final neural state
validation.timestep_sensitivity: report aggregate MN spike rate relative difference, recruitedMN and RMS filtered rate difference .5 vs .25; engineering sensitivity flag if aggregate rate relative difference exceeds .25 or recruited count changes by more than .25 of323; this is not convergence proof
validation.delay: emit at interval END and receive at START exactly2ms later; ring has delay_steps+1 slots,4 or8 delay steps
validation.counts: report actual ConductanceNetwork step calls and manual reference iterations separately; physical steps and training updates zero
